comment: Every Fluree AI (Solo) stack path, doc slug, and tool name this plugin's text hard-codes. CI validates it with scripts/check-stack-facts.mjs. Keep this SMALL: the stack-first doctrine exists so the knowledge lives on the stack, not here — this file exists for the handful of addresses the choreography cannot avoid naming.

router_endpoints.why: the pre-auth discovery probe the whole connect choreography opens with
RFC 9728 — how an MCP client finds the authorization server for /v1/mcp
RFC 8414 — the metadata `claude mcp add` reads to run the OAuth flow unattended
the Space MCP endpoint the plugin registers; auth is the reason the OAuth discovery above matters
cited as the authenticated place a stack's exact version lives (well-known deliberately omits it)

api_prefixes.why: the default api_base_url; `fluree remote add` takes the stack origin with this suffix

ui_paths.why: llms.txt-style public docs index — the HTTP fallback when stack docs MCP tools are absent
raw markdown for one public page
where the human approves the CLI's device code
the signed-in rendering of a page, including pages the public index withholds

doc_slugs.why: outside the public allowlist as of solo main — the plugin sends users to the signed-in /docs URL for it. Flip to public (and relink) if solo#1040 B4 widens the allowlist.
